APPROX. NORTH
= sheet-bottom
CONFIRMED NUMBERS: 3.810 x 4.572 m
nominal; 15 ft side on the outer west
wall (homeowner-confirmed). Axis
allocation and global position are
proposed.
RELATIONS (compass): wardrobe south
(u=0); entry south wall, beside wardrobe
toward east; headboard west (v=max, 15
ft outer wall); TV east (v=0); study
east side, toward the north end; curtain
north-west corner on the west wall.
LOFT: one continuous assembly above
entrance and wardrobe. Dashed outline is
overhead, not a second cabinet slab.
BED: tenant-supplied queen-to-king
mattress envelope (1524-1829 x 1981 mm),
not joinery. No frame or walking gap
implied. Fixed bedside cabinets are
omitted by the homeowner (HD-14);
tenants may use movable tables. See
OI-BED-01 / OI-R05-03.
WET AREAS: basin left on entry. Feature
tile only on the two shower walls. Close
bath door before basin use.
DIMENSION RECONCILIATION
Local geometry may agree while the assembled shell remains unresolved.

Confirmed numerical dimension
Proposed layout / storage
Unresolved assembly / scope
Dashed outline: overhead loft (held)
Pooja niche (built): estimated front only (HD-16); depth held
R04 MASTER, UTILITY AND POOJA / LAYOUT CORRECTIONS
WALL ROLES (COMPASS)
South wall (sheet top): wardrobe | W03 bay |
wardrobe, loft over. West wall (sheet right):
headboard, with the W04 corner window at its north
end. East wall (sheet left): TV opposite the bed and
door D02 at its north end. North wall (sheet
bottom): dressing passage at its east end. A
wardrobe on the west wall is excluded by topology:
the wall opposite holds the room entry. No room,
wall or nominal size moved.
OPENINGS / HOLDS
D01 is single-leaf in this model, while the
architecture description says double-leaf; confirm
on site. W03 keeps its inherited 913 mm width,
centred (homeowner-confirmed); offsets unmeasured.
The split wardrobe is approved in principle, but the
zones are illustrative and unmeasured; the five
superseded R04 storage records are not drawn
(OI-MBR-03). Beds are tenant-supplied: only the
queen-to-king mattress envelope is shown, with no
frame or walking gap implied (OI-BED-01); fixed
bedside cabinets are omitted by the homeowner
(HD-14: ST-R04-NS01, ST-R04-NS02, ST-R05-NS01; no
optional outline). Concealed curtains in the living,
master and children rooms need two tracks, sheer +
blackout (HD-14); pocket sizes are unverified. The
W03 curtain pocket and the master bed position are
held for lighting (H-MBR-W03, H-MBR-BED).
UTILITY
One continuous east wall runs from the kitchen to
the south corner; no return encloses the washing
corner. The parapet opening reaches that wall face
(0.570 to 4.694 m). Corner wall height to be
site-checked (OI-UTL-02).
POOJA NICHE (HD-16 / HD-18)
Already built, flush with the east wall's room face
as reported (x 0.685 m, estimated z 12.169 to 12.779
m). Front outline only. HD-18 clarifies
feet-and-inches notation: sill 1 ft 5 in (0.4318 m),
depth 1 ft 3 in (381 mm), north-corner gap 1 ft 4 in
(0.4064 m). All remain homeowner estimates, not site
measurements. Opening height 1701.8 mm is derived
from the estimated top minus sill. The homeowner
reports a reinforced slab extension beyond the wall.
Its geometry and capacity are unverified: no
physical back or structural section is drawn.
Confirm dimensions and balcony-edge relation on site
(OI-POOJA-01). No cutting or deepening is
authorised.
DECISIONS & SITE CHECKS / SOURCE OPEN-ITEM REGISTER
Quoted in full from the master. "sheet-N" and legacy wall IDs are drawing labels, not compass; compass names govern.
OI-R05-01 / Children's bedside vs ceiling curtain [FIXED UNIT CONFLICT
NOT APPLICABLE AFTER HD14]
No fixed bedside is supplied. Keep the current curtain/room geometry;
verify any tenant movable table and two-layer curtain stack on site.
OI-R05-02 / Children's window size [OPEN]
Children's-room window width, jamb offsets, sill and head are unmeasured.
Verify the as-built opening and curtain/bed-head relationship on site; this
current layout's window placeholder is not site verified.
OI-R05-03 / Children's study return [HOMEOWNER SELECTED LAYOUT SITE
CLEARANCE HOLD]
Homeowner selected keeping the finalized layout (HD-15). The proposed
bed-foot to study-return gap is approximately 387.6 mm and remains a pinch
point, not a comfortable walking route. Verify actual tenant bed-frame
envelope, fixed return, and unobstructed route on site; do not relocate
furniture in drawings.
OI-R05-04 / Children's door and loft over door [OPEN]
Children's door position, hinge and inward swing are proposed; confirm on
site. Loft soffit 2.13 m is assumed and 2.20 m is a project clearance
target, not a verified statutory minimum. Loft clear height, depth, support
and allowable load are unmeasured; obtain site and professional checks.
OI-R05-05 / Children's room orientation [RESOLVED HOMEOWNER CONFIRMED]
15 ft side is the outer west wall (bed head/curtained window); 12 ft 6 in
along the wardrobe/door wall (HD-03). Matches the current model.
OI-SH-01 / Assembled shell residuals [OPEN]
Dining 110.6 mm and living 145.1 mm open/entry bands; master 41.1 mm
compass-east (sheet-left) model interface; utility and balcony label scope
unresolved; overall area 1643 vs 1590 ft2. These are reconciliation holds,
not measured gaps.
OI-ST-01 / Storage inputs [OPEN]
Basis set: typical tenant family of 3-4 (HD-04); beds are tenant-supplied
(HD-05); budget target mid INR 2.5-3.5 lakh per flat before GST excluding
beds (HD-06). Still unknown: loft clear geometry and load per floor.
OI-BATH-01 / Bath door hinge side [OPEN]
Vanity orientation resolved (HD-07: cabinet faces north, user faces south,
as drawn). Hinge side remains a provisional interpretation; confirm on
site.
OI-MBR-01 / Master-bedroom layout and openings [PROPOSED RESOLUTION]
Wardrobes are on the compass-south wall with W03 in the middle bay; the
headboard is on the west wall with W04 at the far corner; TV and door are
on the east wall. Dressing is adjacent. No room or wall was moved; W03
remains an unmeasured placeholder (OI-MBR-02).
OI-UTL-01 / Straight utility wall [PROPOSED RESOLUTION]
The continuous utility side wall is on the compass-east side (legacy
drawing ID west-upper). The full-height return at the utility end is
removed in the current proposal by extending the parapet opening to the
side-wall inner face. Cardinal orientation is homeowner-confirmed; the true
bearing is not surveyed.
OI-REF-01 / Children's interiro_1 page range [EXCLUDED REFERENCE NOT
USED]
No range selected. Ambiguous interiro_1 pages are unused; R05 retains its
independently authorised Rajesh16-18 relationships unchanged.
OI-MBR-02 / W03 as-built position [OPEN]
Homeowner confirmed W03 is roughly centred on the master's south (sheet-N)
wall (HD-02). Still measure jamb offsets, width, sill and head; confirm
site photo N1 is this room.
OI-MBR-03 / R04 storage re-placement [OPEN SITE MEASUREMENT]
R04 split wardrobe approved in principle. Keep all dimensions as
placeholders until site measurement; no geometry or lighting positions are
released by this decision.
OI-MBR-04 / R04 curtain/lighting recheck [OPEN]
The master-bedroom curtain pocket must follow W03 on the south wall;
recheck MBR-L2 and the W04 curtain stack against the tenant bedside
arrangement. The headboard is on the compass-west wall. Verify actual bed
placement and switch access on site.
OI-UTL-02 / Utility corner wall height [OPEN]
Photo U1 may show the sheet-left wall stepping to parapet height near the
corner; parapet height, grille and corner nib unmeasured.
OI-BED-01 / Tenant-supplied beds [PARTIALLY RESOLVED]
Check actual queen/king bed-frame envelopes, curtain stacks, movable-table
allowances and accessible bedside switches/sockets/readers. Do not
reintroduce fixed bedside cabinets.
OI-POOJA-01 / Existing recessed pooja niche: estimated dimensions and
depth hold (HD-16) [HOMEOWNER ESTIMATES RECORDED SITE STRUCTURE AND
LIGHTING HOLD]
Homeowner estimates: width about 2 ft, sill about 1 ft 5 in, top about 7
ft, depth about 1 ft 3 in and north-corner-to-edge gap about 1 ft 4 in.
These are not site measurements. The reported extension beyond the modeled
wall is not dimensioned and the balcony-edge pair is unresolved. Measure
niche, extension and light feeds; obtain professional review of support and
permissible loads. No cutting or deepening is requested. One fixed platform
is intended roughly halfway up the niche; exact elevation and idol/picture
sizes and positions remain unmeasured. The homeowner selected small idols
with a framed picture behind for display only; site fit, thermal/fire
clearance and support/capacity require verification.
OI-HEIGHT-01 / Floor-to-floor, slab and false-ceiling levels (HD-11)
[OPEN]
Measure on one finished flat: finished floor to slab underside, slab
thickness, floor-finish build-up, perimeter band underside, raised
centre-panel level and any step, the hall cross-beam depth and soffit, and
the kitchen, bathroom, utility and lobby ceiling levels. The drawings use
11 ft floor-to-floor, a 5 in slab and 1.5 in finish (so 3.188 m to the
soffit) and a 9 in band drop (2.959 m). These are homeowner-stated or
derived figures, not site measurements.
